subject: Your dog's 10-second trick
preview_text: One tiny change to their bowl that makes a 15% difference in just 8 weeks.
body_paragraphs: Picture this: you fill your dog's bowl, they inhale it in 30 seconds, then look at you like you starved them. That's not hunger — it's speed. Dogs who eat too fast don't register fullness until it's too late, and that's one reason the pounds pile on.

Here's the one tiny trick that changes everything: split their daily food into two bowls instead of one. Sounds stupid simple, right? But when I tried it with my lab, Max, he stopped begging within five minutes — and over the next month, his belly started slimming down without me cutting a single kibble. The pause between bowls gives their brain time to catch up with their stomach.

I built this exact logic into PupShape's custom meal plan. Open the app, tap 'Today's Meals,' and you'll see your dog's portions already split for morning and evening. No guesswork — just follow the schedule, and watch the scale shift.

Try it right now. Open PupShape: Dog Weight Loss Plan, check your dog's plan, and serve the first bowl. That's it. P.S. — The 15% average weight loss in 8 weeks comes from owners who stick to the split-bowl method. You're already ahead.
